{{Quote|Our ''detectors'' had no trouble following the ''heat particle trail'' from those droids' ''power cells''.|Stormtrooper|<ref name="The Keeper's Secret!">{{StoryCite|story=The Keeper's Secret!|book=Pizzazz 8}}</ref>}}
A '''heat detector''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]].<ref name="RPG" /> A heat detector functioned by examining energy,<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> such as particles of heat,<ref name="COM" /> emitted by another source.<ref name="SWS" /> [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]] were equipped with heat detectors as part of their standard sensor package.<ref name="RPG" />

[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] were capable of tracking [[Droid/Legends|droids]] with heat detectors due to the heat particles emitted by droid [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]].<ref name="COM" /> Heat detectors fitted to [[Seeker (droid)/Legends|seeker droids]] could be fitted with [[infrared scope]]s to detect footprints and other heat sources.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> [[Scarab Mark VI assassin droid]]s used heat detectors, in conjunction with [[pheromone sniffer]]s and [[biorhythm analyzer]]s to track their targets.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
